Aachi Spices and Foods Private Limited.note: The company remains independently operated under the Aachi Group, founded and managed by A.D. Padmasingh Isaac and his family, with no concluded acquisitions by third parties despite previous market speculations.

Ava Cholayil Health & Heritage Private L.note: Ava Cholayil Health & Heritage Private Limited (Ava Cholayil Health Care) is the parent entity/acquirer that bought the Melam brand of spices and assets from M V J Foods in 2015, and it remains operational.

DS Spiceco Private Limited.note: The company is a fully active subsidiary of the Dharampal Satyapal (DS) Group and was formed originally via demerger rather than being acquired.

Empire Spices & Foods Limited.note: Empire Spices & Foods Limited is an independent public limited company established in 1994 and remains fully operational under its own portfolio of brands.

Gharrkul Industries Private Limited.note: Gharrkul Industries Private Limited is an active, independent company managed and owned by its founding family promoters, including managing director Arun Digambar Varangaonkar.

ITC Limited.note: ITC Limited is a major conglomerate that remains independent and has acquired other spice businesses like Sunrise Foods.

Keya Foods International Private Limited.note: Keya Foods International was acquired by VKL Seasoning and private equity firm True North in 2013.

MTR Foods Private Limited.note: MTR Foods was acquired by the Norwegian conglomerate Orkla in 2007 and was later reorganized under Orkla India.

Manpasand Agro Food Private Limited.note: The company remains independently operated by the founding Bajoria family since its inception in 1990.

Nani Agro Foods Private Limited.note: Nani Agro Foods Private Limited is privately owned and operates as an independent spice manufacturing and exporting company.

Paras Spices Private Limited (Orika).note: Paras Spices Private Limited operates independently as an unlisted company led by its founding promoters.

Rajesh Masala and Food Products Private.note: The company operates independently under its founding family promoters in Uttar Pradesh.

Sara Spices.note: Sara Spices operates as an established spice and food division within the Anna Kitex Group conglomerate.

Shyam Spices Limited.note: The company transitioned to a public limited structure and listed on the National Stock Exchange under the name Shyam Dhani Industries Limited.

Surya Masala.note: Surya Masale operates independently as an unfunded spice manufacturer based in Hyderabad.

Ushodaya Enterprises Pvt. Ltd..note: Ushodaya Enterprises operates its Priya Foods division independently as part of the Ramoji Group.
